senses.gloss:
गुह् गुह्, i. 1, गूह, Par. and Ātm.
 1. To conceal, Man. 7, 105; ptcple. of the pf. pass., गूढ,
 1. Secret, Man. 7, 186.
 2. Disguised, Man. 9, 261. ढम्, adv. Privately, Daśak. in Chr. 191, 13. ढे, loc. adv. Secretly, Man. 9, 170.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass., गुह्य,
 1. To be concealed, Man. 11, 265.
 2. Hidden, MBh. 3, 173.
 3. Mysterious, Bhag. 18, 63. यम्, adv. Solitarily, MBh. 12, 902. n.
 1. A secret, MBh. 13, 5876; a mystery, Man. 12, 117.
 2. Pudendum, Suśr. 1, 116, 7.
 --Comp.
 देव-गुह्य, n. a mystery known only to the gods, Rām. 5, 27, 33.
 --With the prep. अप अप,
 1. To cover, MBh. 5, 7246.
 2. To embrace, Pañc. iii. d. 191.
 --With उप उप, To embrace; उपगाढ, n. An embrace, Megh. 95.
 --With समुप सम्-उप, To embrace, Caurap. 6.
 --With नि नि,
 1. To cover, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 24.
 2. To conceal, Pañc. 36, 20. निगूढ + तर, Well-concealed, [] Pañc. 46, 7. निगूढ + म्, adv. Privately, Kathās. 5, 65.
 --With विनि वि-नि, To conceal, Rām. 5, 20, 6.
 --With वि वि, विगूढ,
 1. Concealed, Man. 9, 260.
 2. Scarcely perceivable, Bhāg. P. 5, 5, 31.
 3. Blamed.
 --Cf. कुहक.

गुह गुह् + अ, m.
 1. A name of Skanda, the god of war, MBh. 13, 4093.
 2. A name of Śiva, MBh. 13, 1263.
 3. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 12, 7559.

गुहा गुह् + आ, f.
 1. A cave, Rām. 1, 6, 20.
 2. The heart, Bhāg. P. 2, 9, 24; cf. Śvet. Up. 3, 20.
गुह्यक गुह्य + क (vb. गुह्), m. A class of demigods attendant upon Kuvera, Man. 12, 47.
गुह्यमय गुह्य + मय, adj. in सर्व-, Comprehending all mysteries, MBh. 1, 5431.
गूहन गूहन, i. e. गुह् + अन, n. Concealment, MBh. 11, 820.

गुहा- + शय गुहा- + शय,
 I. adj. 1. reposing in the heart, Bhāg. P. 3, 28, 19. 2. haunting caves, Suśr. 1, 200, 7.
 II. m. 1. a tiger. 2. Viṣṇu.
